annotations.text:
0 — Point at a repo

One GitHub URL. The app is cloned and served inside the devbox, which is what lets a run target a specific commit — and makes every branch cheap to fork.

Press the button to watch it clone, build, sign in and capture the fixture.

1 — Build the tree

Chat only. No browser, no screenshots, nothing executed. Every card stores an intent in plain words.

Shown here AFTER run 42, which is the interesting state: eight steps verified, one red because its wording matched nothing on the page. Use the suggestions to adopt, reword or drop.

2 — Run, idle

Pick the trigger, check the fixture, press Run. The estimate tracks tree DEPTH, not path count — that is the whole bet.

3 — Run, results

Green means the path still works, red means it failed. That is the whole legend.

Where it matters, a green node says why it nearly did not: "passed · UI changed" is the agent following a renamed control instead of failing on it. Click any node for the screenshot diff and log; press Re-run to watch the tree repaint.

…and back to Build

A red card in Build is a bug in the TREE. A red node here is a bug in the APP. Keeping those apart is why the two routes are separate.
